title: Section B practice questions and mark scheme, own exam-style
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y11 lesson 43 (Section B practice questions and mark scheme, own exam-style (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 43: Paper 1 final recall: case studies and the physical fieldwork section. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Complete the Paper 1 case study recall grid from memory (six case studies, five facts each), then correct in a second colour.
questions.a: Accurate grid; corrections show gaps to revise
questions.model: Teacher completes the Christchurch row aloud from memory.

questions.q: (a) Identify one secondary source for a river enquiry.
(b) Explain one method of presenting river data.
questions.a: e.g. scatter graph of width against distance with reason

questions.q: (c) Evaluate the methods used to collect data in your own physical enquiry.
questions.a: strengths, limits and judgement on own methods

questions.q: Write a 'last look' card with the ten facts you most need.
Give two figures for the Nepal 2015 earthquake.
questions.model: I picture my case study card. Date: 25 April 2015. Magnitude 7.8; about 9,000 deaths.

questions.q: State one quantitative method for a river enquiry.
questions.a: Measuring channel width, depth or velocity
